newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grinaker unbundling announcement next week.
newsitem.headline: Grinaker unbundling announcement next week.

text.p: South Africa's Grinaker Holdings Ltd said Tuesday that it would make an eagerly awaited announcement next week on plans about unbundling and separately listing its investment in Grinaker Construction Ltd.
"The announcement will be made next week. We are not yet ready to make it," Grinaker Holdings managing director Jack Saulez told Reuters.
Saulez said the exact details had not been finalised and declined to give any specifics on the shape of the restructuring.
"It is taking longer than we anticipated to resolve and we are still working on it," he added.
The firm first announced its intention to thrash out a restructuring in June and the group's share price rose strongly on the news.
Analysts see unbundling the construction arm as a positive step that would separate it from Grinaker's electronics businesses Grintek, Siltek and Grinaker Electronics.

Many analysts see little business rationale linking the two halves of the holding firm. "Investors want the firm to unbundle so they can choose to put their money in either electronics or construction, not have to be in both," one analyst said.

In August the firm said talks on restructuring links to Siltek had ended, but that it was still mulling splitting off construction and a partial rationalisation of the current pyramid structure of the electronics units.
At 1345 GMT Grinaker shares were up 60 cents to 25.10 rand ($5.59).
-- Paul Harris, Johannesburg newsroom + 27 11 482 1003 ($ = 4.483 South African Rand)
